name: Reihoku (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Reihoku town emblem in white: a ring with a winged top enclosing a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Reihoku, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 October 1962.

features.role: Reihoku town emblem — a ring with a winged top enclosing a stylised device
